technical.summary: Mixed technicals with bullish trend structure (supertrend, Ichimoku) offset by weak momentum (RSI, stochastic, MACD), price below key moving averages, and low volatility squeeze—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: IEF (iShares 7-10 Year Treasury ETF) shows no fundamental signals; as a bond ETF, insider/institutional/contract data are not applicable to equity analysis framework.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; extreme market fear (36/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trade data (805+ days old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229.6) indicates extreme market stress; IEF (bond ETF) faces headwinds despite typical safe-haven demand in crisis.
